title: Which Se Is It?
goal: Tell reflexive, reciprocal, passive, impersonal and accidental se apart.

items: I can tell reflexive, reciprocal, passive, impersonal and accidental se apart.
I can say that something happened to me by accident with se me.
I can use the new words for hugging, forgetting, losing and dropping things.
